subject: Operations
title: Currency Risk in Operations
description: One-minute skill: Currency Risk in Operations.

hook.text: A US company signs a contract in euros. The dollar weakens 10%. That contract now costs 10% more than planned.

buildup.text: Currency fluctuations change the real cost of imported materials, exported goods, and overseas profits.

discovery.text: Companies manage currency risk through hedging, natural hedging, and pricing strategies that pass risk to customers.

twist.text: Even hedging has limits. Long-term currency shifts can make an entire sourcing strategy uneconomical.

climax.text: Toyota builds factories in its major markets. Producing locally in local currency is the ultimate natural hedge.

punchline.text: Currencies move. Plan for it or pay for it.

quiz.question: What is natural hedging?
options: Producing locally in the same currency as sales
